purpose: Teach: 爽快/ババ/チカ/取り込み/近かっ/つらく/こぎ/じゃう

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お風呂、長湯したら、爽快な気分、味わえたな、私。
lines.en: A long soak in the bath — I felt that sense of freshness wash over me, you know.
lines.style: Soft, nostalgic opening. Voice settles into the memory with quiet satisfaction. Warm, measured pace. Gentle trailing-off as if savoring the moment still.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん。孫と、ババ抜き、楽しい時間だったわね、昨日。
lines.en: Yes. Playing Old Maid with our grandchild yesterday was such a lovely time, wasn't it?
lines.style: Warm, affectionate tone. Small lift of joy on the memory. Conversational, speaking as if sharing something still close. Slight rise at the end—inviting agreement.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 目、最近、チカチカするんだよ、ばあさん、心配だ。
lines.en: My eyes have been bothering me lately, you know. All this flickering. I'm worried about it, honestly.
lines.style: Shift toward concern but not alarm. Quieter, more direct. Seeking acknowledgment without dramatizing. Voice steadies on the worry—real, present.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お電話、取り込み中で、出られなかったわ、息子から。
lines.en: Our son called, but I couldn't pick up — I was in the middle of something.
lines.style: Light, matter-of-fact. A small note of mild regret underneath, held lightly. Not dwelling on it. Acceptance in the pacing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 昔の借家、駅から近かったな、新婚時代の。
lines.en: That old rental place we lived in when we were first married — it was so close to the station, remember?
lines.style: Voice softens into deep memory. Slower pace, almost reverent. The sentence unfolds like she's seeing it again. Warmth beneath the wistfulness.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 最近、夜が、つらくなってきたわ、寒さで、私。
lines.en: These nights have been getting harder for me lately with the cold. It really takes it out of me.
lines.style: Quiet honesty. Smaller voice, more vulnerable. No complaint in the tone, just straightforward acknowledgment. Slightly tired breath underneath.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、池で、ボートこぎ、よくやったな、二人で。
lines.en: When we were young, we used to row the boat on that pond all the time, just the two of us.
lines.style: Gentle, almost dreamy. Warm affection settles over the memory. Slow, easy pace. Voice carries the contentment of something lived fully, now held tenderly.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: ジュース、孫が、全部飲んじゃうのよね、おかわりおかわりって。
lines.en: Our grandchild drinks all the juice — keeps asking for more and more. It's endless.
lines.style: Fond exasperation, but genuinely warm. Light, almost amused tone. Voice shows she doesn't mind at all. Slight shake of the head in the delivery, laughing with it.
